# Pico - LLMs.txt
# https://picogpt.app
# Version: 2.0.0

# ABOUT
Pico builds privacy-first AI apps for Apple Silicon. Every Pico app runs state-of-the-art
AI models locally on the user's Mac — fast, offline, and entirely on-device. Nothing is
sent to the cloud. The apps are powered by Apple's MLX framework and distributed through
the Mac App Store.

# PRODUCTS

## Pico AI Server
A complete local LLM server for Apple Silicon. 100% OpenAI- and Ollama-API compatible,
powered by Apple's MLX engine. Offers 300+ ready-to-use models (DeepSeek, Llama, Gemma,
Qwen, and more) that can be served to any compatible app on the Mac or local network.
- Platform: macOS (Apple Silicon, M1 or later)
- Requirements: 16GB RAM (32GB recommended for larger models)
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/pico-local-ai-chat-server/id6738607769
- Capabilities: local LLM inference, Chat API, Embeddings API, Models API, RAG,
  Bonjour service discovery, OpenAI/Ollama API compatibility

## Pico Flux
On-device AI image generation for the Mac. Creates images with state-of-the-art generative
models running entirely on Apple Silicon — no cloud, no credits, no queues.
- Platform: macOS (Apple Silicon, M1 or later)
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/pico-flux-ai-image/id6725615977

## Pico Studio
A native AI assistant and chat front-end for local models. A new version is in development;
the current version is available on the App Store.
- Status: Coming soon (new version in development)
- App Store (current version): https://apps.apple.com/us/app/pico-llm-frontend-ai-assistant/id1668205047

# KEY BENEFITS
- Privacy: all data and models run locally; nothing leaves the device
- Speed: native apps optimized for Apple Silicon and Apple's MLX framework
- Ownership: no accounts, no subscriptions, no metered usage
- Simplicity: one-click install from the Mac App Store

# INTENDED USE
- Professional and enterprise use
- Small team collaboration
- Privacy-focused applications
- Local AI development
- Homelab setups

# ETHICAL CONSIDERATIONS
- Promotes data privacy by keeping all processing local
- Reduces cloud dependency
- No data collection or sharing

# LIMITATIONS
- Requires Apple Silicon hardware
- Performance varies by device capabilities
- Model availability subject to licensing terms
